direct_user_formula.A: j1*j2 or a defined shears slope
direct_user_formula.condition: If all quantities are fixed, J2 is constant; theta dependence requires A,V2,Jcore or I0 to vary with theta/I.

constrained_particle_rotor_derivation.closure: theta->0 gives c->1 and finite omega_s=3V2/A; dE/dtheta and dI/dtheta both vanish as sin(theta), so no singularity in the ratio.

signs.V2_positive: positive curvature and positive J2 in the quadratic model
signs.V2_zero: shears-only linearization has divergent J2; a finite J2 requires core inertia or higher-order terms
signs.negative_finite_difference: not automatically a physical negative inertia; inspect level ordering, line overlap, backbend and uncertainties
